+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ident', ('2', '2a', '2y', '2b'))
+def test_bcrypt_ident_passlib(ident):
+    if not encrypt.PASSLIB_AVAILABLE:
+        pytest.skip('passlib not available')
+    result = get_encrypted_password('secret', 'blowfish', salt='123456789012345678901u', rounds=4, ident=ident)
+    assert result.startswith('$%s$04$123456789012345678901u' % ident)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ident', ('2a', '2y', '2b'))
+def test_bcrypt_ident_crypt(ident):
+    if not encrypt.HAS_CRYPT or sys.platform.startswith('darwin'):
+        pytest.skip('crypt not available')
+    result = encrypt.CryptHash('bcrypt').hash('secret', salt='123456789012345678901u', rounds=4, ident=ident)
+    assert result.startswith('$%s$04$123456789012345678901u' % ident)
+
+
+def test_ident_ignored_for_other_algorithms():
+    assert get_encrypted_password('123', 'sha256', salt='12345678', ident='2b') == get_encrypted_password('123', 'sha256', salt='12345678')
